items.title: Last day to file objection (Einspruch) against the interest assessment
items.quote: Einspruch ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich, schriftlich oder elektronisch beim Finanzamt Musterbergen; als Tag der Bekanntgabe eines einfachen Briefs gilt der vierte Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post.
items.computation: Letter dated 09.04.2027 (Friday), assumed posted that day. Deemed notification is the fourth day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 AO as amended): 13.04.2027 (Tuesday). One-month period (§ 355 AO, § 108 AO, §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the day after, so it ends on 13.05.2027. That is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW (Ascension is 06.05.2027). No extension applies. If the letter was actually posted on 06.04.2027 (the date of the Bescheid), the deadline would be 10.05.2027.

warnings: The letter is dated 09.04.2027 but refers to a Bescheid dated 06.04.2027; the posting date is unknown, so the objection deadline could be as early as 10.05.2027 if it was posted on 06.04.2027. To be safe, file by 10.05.2027.
The interest of 46,00 € is paid out with the refund, so no payment is required from you.
